findings.text: follow-on: the fixture hand-builds the worktree_retention and release sub-maps rather than driving the real promotion path, so a change to how reckon/crew/promotion.py writes release.worktree_released would leave these cases green while the release guard silently stopped firing; the module docstring's 'built by the ledger's own constructor' oversells it, since the constructor covers only the top-level record.

item_verdicts.diff: read e2a8eac against 9b66ff8a commit by commit; c8164115f adds path.is_dir() to the registered-worktree set and a release.worktree_released skip in _held_worktrees_by_session plus the new test file, and e2a8eac30 adds the evidence fragment; no other path changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a deleted-tree case, a kept-tree case and a negative control dropping the on-disk check; tests/test_worktree_held_names_an_existing_tree.py carries the deleted-tree case (with Git still listing the path asserted as a positive control), the kept-tree case and a release case, and negative-control.log records the deleted-tree case failing once the check is dropped (1 failed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to raise worktree-held only for a worktree directory that exists on disk and that no promotion record shows released; reckon/crew/obligations.py:_held_worktrees_by_session now filters Git's registered worktrees by path.is_dir() and skips any matched record whose release.worktree_released is True, so both stated conditions hold.
item_verdicts.manifest: read against the tree; status complete, commits c8164115f (code and tests) and e2a8eac30 (evidence fragment); baseline_suite 2 failed / 236 passed at 9b66ff8a (EXIT=1, both new cases), after_suite 238 passed at c8164115f (EXIT=0), negative control 1 failed (EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_worktree_held_names_an_existing_tree.py and an evidence fragment; git diff --stat 9b66ff8a..e2a8eac touches exactly those three paths, all inside the grant, and the reviewed worktree is clean at e2a8eac.

justifications.durability: two guards are each load-bearing and each is pinned by a case that fails when its guard is removed (muting reckon/crew/obligations.py:574-578 reds test_a_promoted_run_whose_tree_was_deleted_is_not_held; removing 623-628 reds test_a_record_showing_the_tree_released_is_not_held), and the release sub-record the test builds matches the shape reckon/crew/promotion.py:6152 writes; cut because the fixture hand-builds the worktree_retention and release sub-maps rather than driving the real promotion path, so the guard's coupling to the producer is untested here.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's three measures are all present and I reproduced them independently in a scratch tree at e2a8eac (head 238 passed, EXIT=0; base 2 failed/236 passed, EXIT=1; my own is_dir-free mutation reds the deleted-tree case, my release-free mutation reds the released case); cut because the base arm ran the new test file copied into the base tree without the manifest saying so, so a reader must infer the overlay from the failure ids rather than read it stated.
justifications.fit: the diff mirrors the module's own idioms - the isinstance(..., Mapping) guard at reckon/crew/obligations.py:624 matches the retention guard at 629-631 - and adds no name the repository naming rules forbid; cut because the function docstring at 549-554 and the test module docstring both widen slightly past what the code guarantees.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both conditions the goal names are implemented at reckon/crew/obligations.py:574-578 (path.is_dir()) and 623-628 (release.worktree_released skip), the base arm reproduces the deleted-tree and released cases as failing (base-arm3.log), and the head arm greens them (238 passed); cut one point because the release verdict is read only as release.worktree_released is True, so any other spelling of a release in a future record would read as held.
justifications.scope_discipline: two commits touching exactly three paths, all inside the run's declared grant, with the plan, project index and peer paths untouched and the worktree clean at e2a8eac; ruff check and format --check over the two changed Python files report no finding and no reformat; cut one point because the evidence fragment is a declared path the goal does not imply, in-grant but not required by the measure.
